scope: Ordinary pivot numerical consistency under supplied analyst context; no automatic master selection or full-method validation

clauses.behavior: Use closed available candles and prior ATR from each level own timeframe for evidence and original role breaks; require matching data identity and sufficient history.
Select nearest opposing supplied level and nearest structural-timeframe opposing supplied level separately; intermediate unknown or overlapping obstacles must not be skipped.

Freeze at scenario start open, or latest available trigger decision for a map. Use max declared and calculated effective availability; no future confirmations. A consumed nearest target or invalidated scenario cannot roll to farther levels.
Preserve original timeframe and level identity; broken role requires a new evidenced identity; no automatic promotion, merging or reversal.

Target validation requires fresh aligned available three-timeframe data. Readiness also requires aligned direction, reviewed anchor, matching target, confirmed trigger, known-at-origin dependencies and a clear supplied path.

Trex primary; MACD/Fibonacci auxiliary. structural_target_contract_consistent reports numerical consistency only. Preserve SEM-03: method_scope.structural_target_validated and full_method_validated remain false pending independent method adjudication. No exhaustive inventory, fill, risk or profitability inference.
